messages:
Tara: heads-up deploy-bot placed staging promo on HOLD — image extract failures during canary startup and a couple flaky smoke tests. change window in 35m.

deploy-bot: PROMO_HOLD staging canary v2026.8.30 -> v2026.8.31
checks: image-extract: FAILED (tar extract error: unexpected EOF in layer 4)
smoke: 3/6 passed (healthcheck x2 timeout, metrics-init x1 failure)
build logs: https://ci.internal/4412609999/build/21

Devon: unexpected EOF in layer 4 suggests corrupted layer blob or interrupted upload. ci-bot, did the registry report any multipart issues during the build push?

ci-bot: REGISTRY_LOG: push v2026.8.31 completed with 2 retries on layer upload. multipart finalize returned 5xx twice at 03:07 UTC. No permanent 404s.

ops-bot: INFRA_ALERT: registry S3-backed storage reported elevated 5xx and transient timeouts between 03:05-03:12 UTC in us-east-2. cache-pruner ran at 03:10 UTC; eviction window overlapped push time.

Priya: change window is tight. product really needs the release. Options: A) pin promote to previous working image v2026.8.30 and manual promote, B) force rebuild and push new image then re-run canary (risk missing window), C) delay cut. Thoughts?

Tara: pin trades feature inclusion for meeting customer SLA. rebuild may succeed but given registry 5xx and prune overlap, we might hit same issue. I lean pin + follow-up rebuild once infra stabilized.

Devon: agree. we'll lose the new feature but preserve the release. we'll also add a guard in CI to verify layer checksums after push and block on finalize errors. Open a postmortem ticket on registry prune timing.

Priya: product accepts pin if we document follow-up: reintroduce feature in next patch and include rollback/rollback-rollback notes. I'll draft release note. Can someone open the promo-pin PR?

Tara: @Devon can you open PR and prepare manual promote playbook? Also open infra ticket to correlate cache-pruner schedule with pushes.

Devon: creating promo-pin PR now: https://git.internal/repo/promo-pin/2055. Manual promote runbook drafted. Infra ticket opened: https://infra.internal/tickets/1933. CI ticket to add checksum post-push: https://ci.internal/tickets/88.

qa: follow-up: QA will schedule an immediate smoke rerun after infra stabilizes to confirm extract and healthcheck. tagging @oncall.

deploy-bot: ACTION: promo pinned to v2026.8.30 (manual override) by Devon at 4412610150. Release window preserved.

Tara: thanks. Release note draft: "Pinned staging image to v2026.8.30 due to transient registry/storage errors causing a corrupted layer upload for v2026.8.31. Feature Z deferred to next patch. Follow-ups: infra to review prune schedule, CI to add post-push checksum validation, QA to smoke-verify rebuilt image. Contact: @Tara."

Priya: will publish the note and notify product. closing hold. :white_check_mark:
